name: cents_vs_dollars_threshold
title: Free shipping over $50
body: Non-members now ship free when the cart is $50 or more.

+
+FREE_SHIPPING_OVER_DOLLARS = 50
 
 
 @dataclass

 def shipping_cents(cart: Cart) -> int:

+    return 599
